scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
